_comment: The full-slice rules_cksum each derived arm was built from. An arm here is defined as a transformation of rules/laconic.md's `full` slice - a deletion, a replacement, a swapped block - so it only means what evals/arms/README.md says it means against the slice it was cut from. When rules/laconic.md moves, these arms go stale: tests/test_bench.py stops asserting invariants that can no longer hold, and run.py refuses to generate with one. Rebuilding a stale arm is a deliberate act and belongs to the round that needs it. The laconic-min-* arms are absent on purpose: they are independent rewrites to a content specification, not transformations of a slice.
